question: What claim about the authority of the yoginī named Icchā is at stake in stating that she is known by the siddhas up to Māyā by supreme will?
premises: The yoginī named Icchā is named thus.
She is known by the siddhas.
Her scope extends up to Māyā by supreme will.
inference: The yoginī Icchā is known by the siddhas as extending up to Māyā through supreme will.
uncertainties: The precise mode of being known by the siddhas is not specified here.
plain_english: The yoginī named Icchā is known by the siddhas up to Māyā by supreme will.
